connector.name: Science AI Journal MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Academic peer-review, research-gap finding, journal recommender, and article writer tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package science-ai-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the selfpy account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCIENCE_AI_API_KEY
env.description: Your Science AI Journal API key. Generate at https://scienceaijournal.com/settings?section=api-keys. Required for all tool invocations.

env.name: SCIENCE_AI_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Science AI Journal base URL (default: https://scienceaijournal.com). Only needed for self-hosted or staging environments.
